pearls.purpose: Wholesale-tier operator console — manages a fleet of operator ccash installs (sub-accounts, correspondent ledger, revocation registry). Issues SubAccountCap capabilities to operator Pearls so they can settle through the wholesale ledger. Storage is plain JSON for the correspondent ledger (no operator-private secrets); identity is delegated to the wholesale Squads vault.

sidecars.label: Grain Crypto Journal
sidecars.purpose: Correspondent ledger is plain JSON under DATA_DIR/correspondents.json — no per-user secrets.

sidecars.label: Grain Restore
sidecars.purpose: Plain-file state; restore = standard grain backup.

offers.name: wholesale-admin
offers.purpose: Surface wholesale admin to a peer admin grain (manage operator allowlist, correspondent rules).

offers.name: sub-account-cap
offers.purpose: Issue a scoped sub-account capability to an operator Pearl so it can settle through this wholesale install.

requests.name: domain-template
requests.purpose: Resolve the wholesale's domain template (regulatory profile, allowed currencies).

adminOnly.name: Add/remove operator install
adminOnly.purpose: Squads-signed; adds an operator to the wholesale's allowlist.

adminOnly.name: Issue revocation
adminOnly.purpose: Revoke a sub-account cap; effective on next claim.

blockchains.purpose: Wholesale admin actions are Squads-vault-signed; sub-account caps reference a license-registry-anchored authority chain.

interfaces.name: ccash.WholesaleAdmin@1
interfaces.purpose: Surface wholesale admin to a peer admin grain (manage operator allowlist, correspondent rules).

interfaces.name: ccash.SubAccountCap@1
interfaces.purpose: Issue a scoped sub-account capability to an operator Pearl so it can settle through this wholesale install.
